header.title: Overall dependency ratio by District Council district
tablenote: Figures are compiled based on the survey results of the General Household Survey (GHS) from January to December of the year concerned as well as the mid-year population estimates and may be regarded as referring to the overall situation of the whole year.     The GHS covers the land-based non-institutional population and thus does not cover (a) inmates of institutions; and (b) persons living on board vessels. The land-based non-institutional population constitutes about 99% of the Hong Kong Resident Population.
